integrity: Finite enumeration and independent implementation agree; the standalone reproducer checks all 787320 candidates and both symmetry orbits. No independent external scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact claim concerns only ternary cyclic sequences, four-symbol windows and Hamming radius one. It is certified by finite exhaustive enumeration of every candidate of lengths 9--12; it is not a general analytic classification for other parameters. Prior unindexed finite enumerations remain a possible overlap.
title: Exact ternary radius-one cyclic covering length four and its unique symmetry class
